vísur:
Pale leaves drift on a restless wind
The moon hangs sharp a blade of cold light
Metal sighs in the rust of fallen crowns
Conflict murmurs low as ash in the air
Metal echo fades the forge grows quiet
Autumn breathes gold upon shattered stone
The sky burns with a relentless lunar spear
Shadows melt into the copper of fading fields
Machines hum in the hush of harvest night
Freedom rides the wind beyond the metal veil
háttr: Eitt erindi, tíu línur, sem eitt andartak — engi punktr fyrr en at lyktum.
